abstract: Positive cases of serum human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) have been increased in patients with pure seminoma due to the progress of methods of measuring serum hCG. But the positive ratio and the value of serum hCG in pure seminoma cases are lower than those of non-seminoma cases. The relationship between the pathological type of testicular tumor and the hCG levels in both serum and tumor tissue was investigated, and clinical usefulness of the serum hCG levels as a tumor marker of pure seminoma was discussed. The materials were 19 pure seminomas, 14 non-seminomas and 11 normal testes as controls. HCG and hCG-beta in tumor tissue extracts and in the serum of blood from the spermatic and peripheral veins were measured by radioimmunoassay (RIA). The tissue content of hCG and hCG-beta were 276.7 +/- 136.1 mIU/g.tissue and 16.5 +/- 3.20 ng/g.tissue, respectively, in pure seminoma; 224,376 +/- 91,619 mIU/g.tissue and 4,608 +/- 1,817 ng/g.tissue, respectively, in non-seminoma including choriocarcinoma component; 1,807 +/- 1,428 mIU/g.tissue, and 37.0 +/- 11.2 ng/g.tissue, respectively, in non-seminoma including seminoma component but not including choriocarcinoma component; 20.4 +/- 3.1 mIU/g.tissue and 1.27 +/- 0.38 ng/g.tissue, respectively, in normal testes, (each M +/- SE). The tissue content of hCG-beta in pure seminoma is significantly higher than that in normal testis (p less than 0.01) and significantly lower than that in non-seminoma including choriocarcinoma component.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 測定法の進歩により、純粋セミノーマ症例における血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の陽性例は増加している。しかし、純粋セミノーマ症例の陽性率および血清hCG値は、非セミノーマ症例よりも低い。精巣腫瘍の病理型と、血清および腫瘍組織中のhCG値との関係を検討し、純粋セミノーマの腫瘍マーカーとしての血清hCG値の臨床的有用性について考察した。対象は純粋セミノーマ19例、非セミノーマ14例、および対照として正常精巣11例である。腫瘍組織抽出物および精索静脈と末梢静脈の血清中のhCGおよびhCG-βを、ラジオイムノアッセイ(RIA)で測定した。腫瘍組織中のhCG含有量およびhCG-β含有量は、純粋セミノーマではそれぞれ276.7 ± 136.1 mIU/g組織および16.5 ± 3.20 ng/g組織、絨毛癌成分を含む非セミノーマではそれぞれ224,376 ± 91,619 mIU/g組織および4,608 ± 1,817 ng/g組織、セミノーマ成分を含み絨毛癌成分を含まない非セミノーマではそれぞれ1,807 ± 1,428 mIU/g組織および37.0 ± 11.2 ng/g組織、正常精巣ではそれぞれ20.4 ± 3.1 mIU/g組織および1.27 ± 0.38 ng/g組織であった（各値は平均 ± 標準誤差）。純粋セミノーマの腫瘍組織中hCG-β含有量は正常精巣より有意に高く（p<0.01）、絨毛癌成分を含む非セミノーマより有意に低かった。（抄録は250語で打ち切られている）
